SELECT -- 1. 진행 중 (완료가 아니고, 마감일이 안 지난 것) COUNT(CASE WHEN ts.is_final = 'O2' AND TRUNC(NVL(t.due_date,t.est_end_date)) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 1 END) AS inProgress,
-- 2. 지연됨 (완료가 아니고, 마감일이 지난 것) COUNT(CASE WHEN ts.is_final = 'O2' AND TRUNC(NVL(t.due_date,t.est_end_date)) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 1 END) AS delayed,
-- 3. 마감 임박 (완료가 아니고, 마감일이 오늘부터 3일 이내인 것) COUNT(CASE WHEN ts.is_final = 'O2' AND (TRUNC(NVL(t.due_date,t.est_end_date)) - TRUNC(SYSDATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 3 THEN 1 END) AS pendingPR,
-- 4. 완료 처리됨 COUNT(CASE WHEN ts.is_final = 'O1' THEN 1 END) AS done FROM tasks t JOIN task_statuses ts ON t.task_status_id = ts.task_status_id WHERE t.ASSIGNEE_USER_ID = #{userId} -- 💡 1. 맵핑 테이블 없이 바로 tasks 테이블의 담당자 컬럼을 조회!

SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.project_id AS projectId, p.parent_project_id AS parentProjectId, -- 💡 상위 프로젝트 ID 추출 t.title AS title, (TRUNC(NVL(t.due_date,t.est_end_date)) - TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS dDay, common(t.priority_code) AS priority, tt.type_name AS typeName, ts.status_name AS statusName, ts.is_final AS isFinal, t.progress_rate AS progressRate FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.project_id -- 💡 프로젝트 테이블 조인 LEFT JOIN task_types tt ON t.task_type_id = tt.task_type_id JOIN task_statuses ts ON t.task_status_id = ts.task_status_id WHERE t.ASSIGNEE_USER_ID = #{userId} AND ts.is_final = 'O2' ORDER BY dDay ASC
